context: Mrs. Cho at the Velvet Moon's box office.

lines.speaker: char.albertine_cho
lines.text: Harold is alive. I saw him Tuesday. Third feature, second reel.

lines.speaker: char.albertine_cho
lines.text: He always said he'd be in pictures. Nobody believed him.

lines.speaker: char.albertine_cho
lines.text: I'm not crazy. I'm a widow. It's different.
